tenets.title: We never sell readings.
tenets.body: DOGM.AI is B2B2C, permanently. We sell infrastructure to practitioners; we never sell interpretation to seekers. Every feature proposal is tested against this line, and any that requires crossing it dies in the meeting — because our entire moat (community trust, regulatory alignment, human attestation) evaporates the day we compete with the people we serve.
tenets.oath: If we break this, leave us.

tenets.title: Your voice model is yours.
tenets.body: Trained only on material you provide. Never pooled, never used to train another model, never retained after you leave. Ownership is written into the contract and the architecture — export takes one click, and our copy is deleted on departure.
tenets.oath: Craft is not a dataset to be strip-mined.

tenets.title: Every reading carries its seal.
tenets.body: Human authorship or review, disclosed AI assistance, tamper-evidence — bound to the artifact on C2PA-style rails that verify without us. We make the honest state of every reading checkable by anyone, because trust that can't be verified is just branding.

tenets.title: The guardrails are constitutional.
tenets.body: No health prognoses, no death predictions, no pregnancy calls, no specific financial picks, crisis protocols always on, disclosure by default. These are not settings, not premium toggles, and not up for A/B testing. They are conditions of the platform's existence.
tenets.oath: The vulnerable are not a segment.

tenets.title: We amplify the reader. We never replace them.
tenets.body: AI drafts; the human refines, signs, and answers for the work. The order is the ethic: machine first, human last, on the record. We build for the practitioner's next decade, not for a quarter of engagement metrics.
